concept.title: Concepts of basic operations
concept.shortdesc: Understanding the repository, the main branch, commit and push.

conbody.p: A repository stores the version history of a project.

section.title: Local vs remote repository
section.p: The local repository is on your machine. The remote repository is hosted on .
Changes must be committed locally before they can be pushed to the remote repository.

section.title: Default branch: main
section.p: The main branch contains the stable version of the project.
